rules.starter_scene: Only the starter launch table/pad is present. Every purchasable base expansion is absent until bought.
rules.placement: Every purchase has a deterministic reserved world anchor on the island. The fully developed base must fit without overlapping the launch core or leaving the island.
rules.water: Water is a continuous runtime layer and changes palette/wave response with weather; it is not baked into the island asset.
